speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: The Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth (MCCY) will focus on building a caring, cohesive and confident nation that is enabled by an active citizenry and a vibrant arts and heritage, sports, community and youth landscape.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: There are many challenges we will face as a country in the next chapter of our journey.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: These include economic and demographic challenges, which may affect social cohesion and harmony.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: To rise above these challenges, Singaporeans must have a strong sense of shared identity, trust and engage one another, and exercise their civic responsibilities for the common good.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: MCCY will do more to encourage these qualities and grow a strong society.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: As a member state, we will work towards listing an element on the UNESCO Representative List that reflects our multicultural and multiracial makeup, resonates with Singaporeans, and helps build a greater sense of national identity.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will continue our conversations with the community to define the intangible aspects of our heritage.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: The arts scene is more vibrant today, with more Singaporeans recognising the value of the arts to the individual, community, and to Singapore society.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: This will be complemented by the setting up of a national resource centre to support freelancers in their efforts to excel and enjoy meaningful careers.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Sport has the capacity to inspire and rally a nation.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: When we cheer on our athletes and celebrate their achievements, we reaffirm our identity as one people.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Our contingents achieved their best away performances at the Southeast Asian Games and Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Para Games in Malaysia in 2017 and put in commendable performances at the Commonwealth Games in Australia in April 2018.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: The Government is committed to supporting our athletes’ aspirations and will continue to develop and enhance Singapore’s High Performance Sports system in areas, such as talent identification, coach development and sports science and medicine capabilities.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will work with key sports stakeholders, such as the Singapore National Olympic Council, Singapore National Paralympic Council and the National Sports Associations, to prepare our athletes and rally the nation as One Team Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: A society is cohesive when its members respect one another as equals regardless of differences, and when it works for everyone and not just a few.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will continue to grow the common space for interactions and shared experiences, and promote equal access to arts and heritage, sports and youth programmes, such as ArtReach, SportCares Champions, Saturday Night Lights and Youth Corps Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will expand the range of affordable quality sports programmes at ActiveSG centres, and build on the momentum of Get Active!

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Singapore celebrations, to encourage more Singaporeans to bond through sports.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Using programmes, such as Broadening Religious/Racial Interaction through Dialogue and General Education (BRIDGE), we will increase our support for community-led initiatives that deepen understanding on sensitive issues of race and religion.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: To further promote inclusivity, the Disability Sports Master Plan aims to expand access and opportunities for sports participation to all, regardless of abilities.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will launch two more inclusive gyms and more disability sports programmes, such as Wheelchair Tennis, in 2018.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will continue to grow awareness and outreach of disability sports through platforms, such as the Inclusive Sports Festival, and partnerships with stakeholders like the Ministry of Education, Special Education schools, social service organisations, and other sports stakeholders.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We embarked on the Youth Conversations to provide a platform for youths to engage one another and the Government to build our future Singapore together.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Youth Conversations provide opportunities for young Singaporeans to understand important issues, appreciate one another’s views, negotiate differences, and find new solutions together.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will design conversations around wide ranging issues, such as preparing for jobs in the future economy, bridging social divides, and helping the underprivileged, using various modes of engagement to provide safe spaces for dialogue.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Conversations will also be conducted online to reach out to more youths and enable them to build and sustain connections with one another.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Through the National Youth Fund, we will also support youths who want to initiate projects together to benefit the community and bring Singapore forward.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Communities that look out for and care for one another are the hallmark of a strong society.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will convene more platforms for givers, non-profits, and sector experts to build insights, co-create solutions, and achieve national impact together.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will also encourage and support good neighbourliness through a whole-of-society approach to strengthen a shared sense of responsibility and ownership towards the neighbourhood.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: This enhanced community model will complement efforts to strengthen social service delivery on the ground, and the expansion of the Community Networks for Seniors.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: A strong local ecosystem will support vulnerable families and enable our seniors who want to age in place to do so in the community.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We want to engage them early and help them transit to new roles in the community as they retire.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will tap on their diverse experience and involve them in giving back to society through volunteerism.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: In the process, they can also grow their social networks and stay active and engaged.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Working with partner organisations, such as the Health Promotion Board, People’s Association and healthcare providers, we will progressively expand outreach to more people across Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: A strong society is one that is caring, inclusive and has a shared sense of the past and future.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: A strong society is one where the Singapore spirit is strong, and where we work together to make Singapore a better home.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: In the face of a more complex and unpredictable future, we invite every Singaporean to build an even better Singapore together.
